nodes.label: SCD Type 2 — Slowly Changing Dimension Historical Versioning
nodes.contributor: rationale: Enables full change history; old version closed (is_current=FALSE, valid_to=NOW), new version created (is_current=TRUE). Surrogate keys change between versions; natural key preserved. Applied to t_d_user, t_d_article, t_d_financial_center, t_d_cost_center.

nodes.label: Alembic — Database Migration System (Alembic-Only since v5.0.0)
nodes.contributor: rationale: Replaced custom 2-tier schema/*.sql system. Versioned incremental migrations; alembic_version table for tracking. Baseline migration (20251109_001) consolidates 7 schema files. All environments use same Alembic workflow.

edges.source_location: Both are advanced DB patterns applied together in the same schema to dimension tables

hyperedges.label: Database Pattern Triad — SCD Type 2 + Closure Table + Alembic
hyperedges.rationale: The three advanced DB patterns applied together: SCD Type 2 for dimension versioning, Closure Table for hierarchy, Alembic for managing their schema evolution. All are defined in the baseline migration 20251109_001.
